name: CadCraft
changes_to_copied_files: Library URLs written as /assets/vendor/<lib>/current/ are pinned to the versions listed in release.json.
notes: Save DWG in six versions (2000 to 2018) with sheets, real dimensions and hatch patterns kept, plus DXF 2000. Sheet sets: title blocks filled from the set, one PDF with bookmarks, zip archive. Rebuilt Properties panel. Trim by dragging, lasso selection, split screen, several drawings in tabs, touch screens. New tools: chamfer, hatch, paragraph text, multileaders, stretch, array, quick select, linetypes, layer tools, xrefs, PUBLISH. 3D: union, subtract, intersect, revolve, sweep. LISP routines (APPLOAD) and your own aliases. Add-ons, with the Electrical add-on included. Draft Spanish, not yet reviewed. Recover your work after a crash. Fixed: mirrored blocks.
